text: 【上海正衡金融消费者权益保护中心揭牌 推动金融消保资源整合升级】2026年11月6日，上海正衡金融消费者权益保护中心（以下简称“消保中心”）揭牌仪式在浦东新区汇商大厦举行。金融监管总局金融消费者权益投诉调解中心、上海金融监管局、上海市委金融办、上海市民政局、上海市司法局、上海市市场监管局、中国人民银行上海市分行、上海证监局、浦东新区区委金融办等单位相关负责同志出席，共同见证消保中心揭牌。
text_en: [Shanghai Zhengheng Financial Consumer Rights Protection Center Unveiled to Promote Integration and Upgrading of Financial Consumer Protection Resources] On November 6, 2026, the unveiling ceremony of the Shanghai Zhengheng Financial Consumer Rights Protection Center (hereinafter referred to as the "Consumer Protection Center") was held at Huishang Building in Pudong New Area. Relevant responsible officials from the Financial Consumer Rights Complaint and Mediation Center of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, the Shanghai Municipal Financial Office of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, the Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau, the Shanghai Municipal Justice Bureau, the Shanghai Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai CSRC Bureau, and the Financial Office of the Pudong New Area District Committee attended the event to jointly witness the unveiling of the Consumer Protection Center.
